summary: Your second Sunday review. You answer 8 questions from Days 9 to 14 with a confidence number, turn your confusions into 3 themes, catch up, tag week 2, and plan the real model call (API key, kept out of Git) and week 3.
goal: Say what you know and what you do not about FastAPI, and plan the real model call and week 3.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 8 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Error log: group this week's confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Catch up: tick every unfinished step of Day 8 to Day 14, in order
Run git tag week-2 and see tag: week-2 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan the M2 checkpoint: choose a provider, add .env to .gitignore, and write your week 3 outcome and drop list
Play the Week 2 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
